newsitem.title: USA: Sprint confirms cuts international rates.
newsitem.headline: Sprint confirms cuts international rates.

text.p: Sprint Corp said Monday it cut international weekend telephone rates with a new weekend calling plan.
Under the Sprint Sense International calling plan, weekend calls to Britain cost $0.10 a minute, or the same as a domestic call, and calls to Germany, Italy and France cost $0.30 a minute.
There is a $3.00 monthly fee for the plan, which includes Sprint's domestic flat-rate program.
Sprint said customers on the plan also receive 10 percent cash back from their entire long-distance bill for every year they stay with Sprint. Minimum cash back checks will be $25, the company said.
About half of Sprint's customers' international long-distance calls are made between midnight Friday and midnight Sunday, the company said.
